title: Evidence Leaf Disclosure

brief:
Disclose one leaf of a sealed evidence bundle to a named party, at the discloser's chosen moment, as a bundle of its own that carries the leaf bytes, the Merkle inclusion path, the sealed roots and the recipient, so the recipient re-derives inclusion without receiving anything else. Use when a sealed root was published earlier and one document, result or record now needs to be shown to one reader; when a reviewer asks "show me that leaf"; when deciding what a disclosure reveals about its siblings; or when a disclosure itself must be verifiable and dated. Encodes the disclosure record, what it reveals and does not, the second-disclosure question, and the verifier's checks.

The root was shown earlier. Now one leaf is told, to a named party, when the holder chooses. The move exists so that sealing is not the same as hiding forever, and telling one thing is not the same as telling everything.
